pr_title: Fix a crash when a SourceActor does not occupy space
pr_body:
Fixes #17628 and fixes #17644.
Testcase: Kill a Grenadier with a nuke.

issue_context.title: Red Alert crashes upon nuke dropping
issue_context.body:

```
Red Alert mod version 26796.git.bf314fd
on map 6b57276597014833fc40299909be39a0d3f2ec17 (Ore Gardens by sith_wampa).
Date: 2020-01-28 10:33:56Z
Operating System: Linux (Unix 5.4.15.1)
Runtime Version: Mono 6.4.0 (makepkg/fe64a4765e6 Sat 16 Nov 2019 04:59:42 PM UTC) CLR 4.0.30319.42000
Exception of type `System.NullReferenceException`: Object reference not set to an instance of an object
  at OpenRA.Actor.get_CenterPosition () [0x00006] in <5cc9d33c4358413b9ee3247ef2c5d86e>:0 
  at OpenRA.GameRules.WeaponInfo.Impact (OpenRA.Traits.Target target, OpenRA.Actor firedBy) [0x00005] in <5cc9d33c4358413b9ee3247ef2c5d86e>:0 
  at OpenRA.Mods.Common.Traits.Explodes.OpenRA.Mods.Common.Traits.INotifyKilled.Killed (OpenRA.Actor self, OpenRA.Traits.AttackInfo e) [0x0013f] in <2ddf29794e6f4c38bb888154b0c473ec>:0

  at OpenRA.Mods.Common.Warheads.SpreadDamageWarhead.DoImpact (OpenRA.WPos pos, OpenRA.Actor firedBy, System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable`1[T] damageModifiers) [0x0012b] in <2ddf29794e6f4c38bb888154b0c473ec>:0 
  at OpenRA.Mods.Common.Warheads.DamageWarhead.DoImpact (OpenRA.Traits.Target target, OpenRA.GameRules.WarheadArgs args) [0x00091] in <2ddf29794e6f4c38bb888154b0c473ec>:0 
  at OpenRA.Effects.DelayedImpact.<Tick>b__5_0 (OpenRA.World w) [0x00007] in <5cc9d33c4358413b9ee3247ef2c5d86e>:0

  at OpenRA.Game.Run () [0x0003c] in <5cc9d33c4358413b9ee3247ef2c5d86e>:0

```

after an ally dropped a nuke on an enemy. Here are my logs: [logs-20200128.zip](https://github.com/OpenRA/OpenRA/files/4121992/logs-20200128.zip). My replay is here: [replay-20200128.zip](https://github.com/OpenRA/OpenRA/files/4121996/replay-20200128.zip).

Thanks for your time
comments: https://github.com/OpenRA/OpenRA/blob/1020a7bfab4ccf109d349520b50249105e50fdcd/OpenRA.Game/GameRules/WeaponInfo.cs#L222 needs a null check and fall back to (I guess?) the target position if there is not a valid `firedBy`.

review_comments: I suspect that leaving `Source` with its default value (I guess `WPos.Zero`) may cause other bugs. We probably want to fall back to `target.CenterPosition` instead.

You're right. I'm not yet sure if defaulting to the target center is better than making this a nullable. (With a nullable the receiver of the args immediately knows that there is no source position. Falling back to the target position will make it harder to detect if there is no real source.)
`Source` doesn't appear to be used in our code (yet), so maybe @reaperrr can explain what the plan for it is and what is best to use here. (I.e. would any code using this actually want to have a special case for when there is no real source?)
Making it nullable is a good idea.
I made it nullable for now.

`Source` is in some cases used to calculate the impact direction in my downstream implementation of directional armor (might try submitting it upstream later), because calculating that from the warhead impact isn't always feasible (lasers, railguns, area beams, InstantHit).

For my use case, falling back to `target.CenterPosition` would have worked, too.
But I guess we can leave it nullable and I'll (try to) adapt my code.
You'll be able to keep the same behaviour using `args.Source ?? args.WeaponTarget.CenterPosition`.
